 ATP Stockholm Best Bets Including Lorenzo Sonego Vs Quentin Halys 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The ATP Stockholm tournament is underway in Sweden. This is an ATP 250 event which is the last tour stop before next week’s ATP Finals in Turin, Italy. The eight spots for Turin have all been decided, so this is just a points-and-money tournament and an opportunity for ATP pros to get in some work before the end of their season. The 2026 ATP Stockholm event is truly a case of last-chance theater. This is what a tournament feels like when it’s the last go-round of a tennis season, and players will compete knowing they will have one and a half months off if not more once their journey in Sweden ends.
 LWOS has our best bets for three matches. Post your best bets and thoughts in the comments.
 ATP Stockholm 
 Alex Michelsen – Juan Manuel Cerundolo: 7:00 EST 
 H2H: 0-1 
 This ATP Stockholm match features Alex Michelsen, who produced a solid hardcourt summer in North America and then played Carlos Alcaraz competitively twice in the fall swing. He is a young and rising player who has reason to think he can build on his 2026 season next year. Juan Manuel Cerundolo is ranked close to 20 spots lower than Michelsen, but both men are 3-2 in their last five matches. On a good day, they are both capable of testing top players. Now they meet to try to keep their respective seasons alive.
 Best Bet to Make 
 Welcome to our best bet section. You’re going to get a collection of bets to consider, also a confidence level which should guide how much you should invest in this match. Both players are 2-3 in their last five matches, so neither player has a clear edge in current form. 
 Parlay/hedge options: Cerundolo +4.5 games at 1.65 at @Interwetten 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 4 – You should not bet more than half a unit on this match.  
 This ATP Stockholm match leans toward Michelsen, who is generally a better player. However, it’s not a match in which you want to bet big because Cerundolo is playing reasonably well and shouldn’t be completely written off in this spot.
 That being said, betting on Michelsen -1.5 sets is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Michelsen -1.5 sets at 1.86 at @1xbet 
 Tomas Martin Etcheverry – Thiago Agustin Tirante: 8:30 EST 
 H2H: 2-1 
 This ATP Stockholm match involves two players searching for consistency. Tomas Martin Etcheverry made a solid run to the Round of 16 last week in Paris, but before that good tournament, he had lost his previous six matches. Thiago Agustin Tirante is 2-5 in his last seven matches. Etcheverry is the sportsbooks’ favorite.
 Mar 9, 2024; Indian Wells, CA, USA; Lorenzo Sonego (ITA) reacts after winning a point in his second round match against Cameron Norrie (GBR) in the BPN Paribas Open at the Indian Wells Tennis Garden. Mandatory Credit: Jayne Kamin-Oncea-USA TODAY Sports | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Shane Black 
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: Tirante +2.5 games at 1.60 at @bet-at-home, Etcheverry moneyline at 1.80 at @unibet 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 1 – you should not bet on this match. 
 This ATP Stockholm match feels like a total toss-up. Two inconsistent players make it hard to trust the winner. This is a match tailor-made for the over 2.5 sets bet, but you probably shouldn’t bet at all if we are being honest.
 That being said, betting on over 2.5 sets is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: over 2.5 sets at 2.20 at @10bet 
 Lorenzo Sonego – Quentin Halys: 8:30 EST 
 H2H: 1-1 
 This ATP Stockholm match has Quentin Halys installed as the sportsbooks’ favorite over Lorenzo Sonego even though Sonego is 4-1 in his last five matches and Halys is 2-3. Why is this the case? Simple: Sonego’s four wins in that batch of matches were all qualifying-round matches. Halys made the Paris Round of 16. Halys has better-quality wins in recent weeks.
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: Halys moneyline at 1.80 at @betway, over 2.5 sets at 2.30 at @betway 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 1 – you should not bet on this match. 
 This ATP Stockholm match is hard to pin down because Sonego’s good current form is based on quallies, not main-draw results. We’ll lean to Sonego on the game spread but think you shouldn’t frankly bet on a match this uncertain.
 That being said, betting on Sonego +2.5 games is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Sonego +2.5 games at 1.60 at @interwetten
